note: S2: per-tenant copy of the master audit chain (libs/core/governance/audit-chain.ts, TENANT_AUDIT_MIRROR_ROOT_PATH): confidential/<tenant>/audit-<date>.jsonl, appended as the tenant-bound audit_mirror_writer only (storage-layout TENANT_STORE_LEDGER_ROOTS); formerly customer/<tenant>/logs/audit/. No TTL of its own: a day file expires together with the master day file (storage-retention-expiry auditChainDayMirrors), and audit_mirror_reconcile rebuilds a drifted copy from the master. personal/confidential subtrees are tenant_scope protected prefixes; tenant offboarding removes a tenant's partition.
